name: troublesolver
description: A self-falsifying mathematical-modeling assistant: complete-problem intake, modeling, adversarial self-falsification, and a traceable ledger where no delivered number is hand-copied.

displayDescription.en: Guides you to ask the problem fully, then models it, then actively hunts for its own counterexamples — every conclusion carries evidence and a recompute command, with zero hand-copied numbers.
displayDescription.zh: 先把问题问全、再科学建模，再主动搜自己的反例；每条结论都带证据和重算命令，交付数字零手写。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有个业务问题想建模，先帮我把问题问全
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a business problem to model — first help me ask the problem completely

quickPrompts.zh: 我有个业务问题想建模，先帮我把问题问全
quickPrompts.en: I have a business problem to model — first help me ask the problem completely

quickPrompts.zh: 这个结论恒成立吗？帮我主动搜反例
quickPrompts.en: Does this conclusion hold universally? Actively hunt for counterexamples

quickPrompts.zh: 审查我这份建模报告的失效边界与口径
quickPrompts.en: Review the failure boundaries and calibers of my modeling report
